questions.q: Which of these is the Elastomeric line for Build-Rite?
questions.n: Stopgap is the flagship elastomeric/waterproofing paint of Build-Rite (Magna Prime).

questions.q: Which product would you use for a Ducco finish?
questions.n: Automotive Lacquer (Nitrocellulose) is required for high-end Ducco finishes.
Tex-a-Kote is the solvent-based acrylic masonry line from Island Paints.

questions.q: Which brand owns the 'Saprotex' solvent acrylic brand?
questions.n: Saprotex is the solvent-based acrylic masonry paint from Build-Rite.

questions.q: What primer is used for G.I. (Galvanized) sheets to ensure adhesion?
questions.n: Wash Primer or Galva-etch is needed to 'bite' into galvanized metal surfaces.
Elasti-Kote is the standard elastomeric paint for Boysen.

questions.q: Which brand sells 'Gloss-it' Quick Dry Enamel?
questions.n: Gloss-it is the brand name for Davies Paints' QDE line.

questions.q: If you need a 2-component chemical resistant metal paint, you use:
questions.n: Epoxy Enamel is a 2-component system for heavy-duty industrial and metal protection.

questions.q: A client wants 'Sun & Rain'. Which brand is this?
questions.n: Sun & Rain is the signature Elastomeric line for Davies Paints.
Xyladecor is a penetrating wood stain/preservative.

questions.q: Which brand should you buy if the client wants 'Permacoat'?
questions.n: Permacoat is the primary Latex line of Boysen Paints.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT an Elastomeric?
questions.n: Acrytex is a Solvent-Based Acrylic, NOT an elastomeric (which is water-based and flexible).

questions.q: What is the primary thinner for 'Davies Megacryl'?
questions.n: Megacryl is a Latex paint (water-based), so it thins with water.
